name: Compact Volume Rendering with Page-Table Indirection and Masked Storage
definition: A rendering mode that stores only selected groups of voxels (bricks) in a packed 2D array texture, using a page table for spatial indexing and an optional bitmask for sparse storage, to fit within a 1024 MiB GPU memory budget.
summary: Compact Volume Rendering stores selected voxel bricks in a packed 2D array using page-table indirection and masked storage to fit large datasets within a 1024 MiB GPU memory budget.
